subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If the outer isolated impl-review execution returns zero aggregates, more than one aggregate, a schema-invalid aggregate, or an aggregate bound to a different process, publication attempt, proposal, or revision, then the system shall reject the handoff, publish nothing, preserve available diagnostic evidence, emit a failed EVT-13 `artifact_unverified` terminal, and keep the required process non-accepting under UB-9
intent: a named missing, surplus, malformed, or binding-mismatch terminal
fit_criterion: one fixture per trigger produces zero proposal writes and receipts, cannot select a favorable aggregate from a surplus set, and converges only after a new valid attempt returns exactly one matching aggregate
